{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''legend keeper''' was a position within the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe<ref name="AOT">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''.</ref> that inhabited [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="EGC 184">The village is named in ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Sometime before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Era">Because the character [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] is a young [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] in ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', the story must take place prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], when Teebo is a young adult. According to {{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM}}, such stories took place around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> [[Arbo (Ewok)|Arbo]] served as the [[City/Legends|village]] legend keeper.<ref name="AOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', a book written by [[Joe Johnston]] and published in [[1984]] by [[Random House]], names Arbo the legend keeper of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[City/Legends|village]];<ref name="AOT" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], also notes this title.<ref name="CSWE I 39">{{CSWECite|I|39|Arbo}}.</ref>
